title: Raise a decision request input
description: The runtime asks a question of a run that waits (after WaitOnDecision). The request is Open until a client answers it.

sdc.daemon.DecisionRequestId.title: DecisionRequestId
sdc.daemon.DecisionRequestId.description: The id of a decision request: the runtime's, copied. A request id that is already taken cannot occur, because the runtime mints it; the specification has no refusal for it.

sdc.daemon.RunId.title: RunId
sdc.daemon.RunId.description: The id of a run. The daemon mints it (a UUID, version 7) in the HTTP handler and returns it in the answer to the submit; the handler fills the `run_id` input of SubmitRun and a client never chooses it. The state directory of the run is named after it. A run id that is already taken cannot occur, because the daemon mints it; the specification has no refusal for it.

sdc.decision.ActionId.title: ActionId
sdc.decision.ActionId.description: A protocol action id, such as roadmap.approve.

sdc.decision.Consequence.title: Consequence
sdc.decision.Consequence.description: What choosing the option does to the protocol.

grant.description: The authority entry the option writes, for an approval.

answer.description: The answer written to questions.yaml, for a question.

produces.description: The kind of Canon record the option produces when decided; absent when it produces none, such as 'leave it untaken' on an outcome request. Only a decided option that produces a record goes through RecordProduced before the run resumes.

sdc.decision.DecisionOption.title: DecisionOption
sdc.decision.DecisionOption.description: One option of a decision request.

does.description: What the option does, one sentence.

cost.description: What it costs: work, time, scope or risk.

sdc.decision.OptionLetter.title: OptionLetter
sdc.decision.OptionLetter.description: The letter of an option: A, B, C, in the order presented.

sdc.decision.ProducedDocument.title: ProducedDocument
sdc.decision.ProducedDocument.description: The Canon record a decided request produced. canon_authority: an AuthorityDecision entry bound to the case revision (approval). canon_decisions: an ExplicitDecision entry (outcome). canon_evidence: the approval evidence a manual action produced (context_approval, vision_approval, roadmap_approval). artifact_revision: the new revision of questions.yaml holding the answer (question).
